title_en: Sichuan Yayu Technology Co., Ltd. v. Yunnan Jinhe Seed Industry Co., Ltd., et al. — dispute over infringement of new plant variety rights
ruling_gist_en: For the infringing act of repeatedly using an authorized variety as a parent to produce reproductive materials of other varieties without permission, when calculating damages for infringement based on the infringer's profits gained from the infringement, the contribution rate of the authorized variety to the profits gained from the infringement shall be considered. If both parents are authorized varieties, the contribution rates of each authorized variety may generally be allocated equally.

full_text_en:
Sichuan Yayu Technology Co., Ltd. v.

Yunnan Jinhe Seed Co., Ltd., et al.

— Dispute over Infringement of Plant Variety Rights

[Ruling Summary]

When calculating damages for infringement based on the profits gained by the infringer from the infringement, in cases where the infringing act involves the repeated use, without authorization, of an authorized variety as a parent to produce propagating material of another variety, consideration shall be given to the contribution rate of the authorized variety to the profits gained from the infringement. Where both parents are authorized varieties, the contribution rate of each authorized variety may generally be allocated equally.

Civil Judgment of the Supreme People's Court

(2022) Zui Gao Fa Zhi Min Zhong No. 789

Appellant (Plaintiff at First Instance): Sichuan Yayu Technology Co., Ltd. Domicile: Room 1406, 14/F, Building 2, No. 387 Tianren Road, Chengdu High-tech Zone, China (Sichuan) Pilot Free Trade Zone.

Legal Representative: Hu Xueai, Chairman of the Board.

Agent ad litem: Chu Zhijuan, lawyer of Sichuan Haotong Law Firm.

Agent ad litem: Sun Lei, lawyer of Sichuan Haotong Law Firm.

Appellant (Defendant at First Instance): Yunnan Jinhe Seed Co., Ltd. Domicile: Room 4152, Unit 4, Building 13, Huachun Yuan, Guandu District, Kunming Area, China (Yunnan) Pilot Free Trade Zone.

Legal Representative: Xu Xingchun, Executive Director and General Manager.

Agent ad litem: Luo Xiong, lawyer of Yunnan Shuangyang Law Firm.

Appellee (Defendant at First Instance): Yunnan Ruihe Seed Co., Ltd. Domicile: Biaogan She, Lianzhu Town, Mojiang County, Pu'er City, Yunnan Province.

Legal Representative: Yang Chao, Executive Director.

Agent ad litem: Luo Xiong, lawyer of Yunnan Shuangyang Law Firm.

The appellants, Sichuan Yayu Technology Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Yayu Company) and Yunnan Jinhe Seed Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Jinhe Company), and the appellee, Yunnan Ruihe Seed Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Ruihe Company), appealed to this Court against the civil judgment (2021) Yun 01 Zhi Min Chu No. 106 (hereinafter referred to as the original judgment) rendered by the Kunming Intermediate People's Court of Yunnan Province (hereinafter referred to as the court of first instance) on October 22, 2021, concerning a dispute over infringement of plant variety rights. This Court accepted the case on April 18, 2022, and formed a collegiate panel according to law. The parties were questioned on July 12, 2022, and September 16, 2022. Chu Zhijuan, the agent ad litem of the appellant Yayu Company, Luo Xiong, the common agent ad litem of the appellant Jinhe Company and the appellee Ruihe Company, attended the questioning on July 12, 2022, and September 16, 2022. Hu Xueai, the legal representative of the appellant Yayu Company, attended the questioning on July 12, 2022. This case is now concluded.

Yayu Company's appeal requests: 1. Affirm items 1 and 2 of the original judgment; 2. Reverse item 3 of the original judgment, and instead order Jinhe Company to compensate Yayu Company for losses from infringement in the amount of RMB 2,284,485, with Ruihe Company bearing joint and several liability; 3. Reverse item 4 of the original judgment, and instead order Jinhe Company to pay Yayu Company punitive damages of RMB 2,284,485, with Ruihe Company bearing joint and several liability; 4. The acceptance fees for the first instance and the appeal shall be borne by Jinhe Company and Ruihe Company. Facts and reasons: (A) The original judgment erred in calculating the "illegal gain amount" or "profits gained from infringement" by deducting "production costs" from the "wholesale unit price" to arrive at the remaining "profit," which constitutes an error in applying the law and should be corrected. First, according to Article 16 of the "Provisions on the Handling of Cases of Infringement of Rights in New Agricultural Plant Varieties" formulated by the former Ministry of Agriculture, the amount of illegal gains shall be calculated based on the result of multiplying the selling price by the quantity sold. According to Article 12 of the "Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Several Issues Concerning the Specific Application of Law in Handling Criminal Cases of Infringement of Intellectual Property Rights," the calculation method for "illegal business turnover" is based on the actual selling price. Although this provision is an interpretation in the criminal field, by reasoning from the heavier to the lighter (a fortiori), this calculation method can serve as a reference for the calculation method in civil infringement cases. The "amount of illegal gains" or "profits gained from infringement" of the infringer should be evaluated as a whole. If a distinction is made between whether the infringer made a profit or not, it will be impossible to effectively pursue legal liability. At the same time, using gross profit, net profit, operating profit, or sales profit cannot yield a consistent conclusion. Therefore, the "amount of illegal gains" or "profits gained from infringement" cannot be simply understood as the amount of illegal profit. Deducting the "costs invested" by the infringer due to the commission of the infringing act in the calculation is not only inconsistent with the legislative intent but also impractical. According to the above calculation method, the "amount of illegal gains" or "profits gained from infringement" in this case is RMB 2,284,485 (30 yuan/kg x 76,149.5 kg). Second, even if production costs are considered, the original judgment's valuation of 20 yuan/kg is unreasonable. Concerning the items to be deducted for production costs, only the procurement cost of the seeds produced and the costs of transportation, processing, and packaging should be limited. Operating costs to maintain the company's operations under circumstances of illegal operations should not be considered. If deducting illegal operating costs while supporting infringement, it would be a disguised encouragement of infringement. Considering differences in regional differences, labor costs, transportation costs, etc., the production cost of corn seeds should be between 8-12 yuan/kg. (B) The court of first instance adopted the "Guidance on the Distribution of Income from Corn Breeding Achievements" regarding the income ratio of the assembler, resulting in a 30% contribution rate of "YA8201" in the allegedly infringing seeds, which is an error in applying the law. First, the "Guidance on the Distribution of Income from Corn Breeding Achievements" is a guidance formulated by the China Seed Association, and internal industry opinions cannot serve as the basis for adjudicating civil cases. Second, regarding the contribution rate of parent seeds, it has practical significance only within the scope of scientific research and when determining the distribution of interests among parties under normal circumstances of authorized use of parent materials and hybrid seeds. However, at the level of legal logic, the contribution rate only has the difference of "existence" or "non-existence." Third, the infringing entity should not be treated as a subject in a legal relationship and allocated income accordingly.

Jinhe Company, in response to Yayu Company's appeal requests, argued: (A) Yayu Company's view that costs should not be considered cannot stand. The production and sale of seeds will generate operating costs, and the court of first instance's allocation of interests and amounts was reasonable. (B) Jinhe Company did not infringe. "Jinhe 880" uses a variant strain of "YA8201" and is a different variety from Yayu Company's authorized variety. During the original trial, Jinhe Company applied for a DUS test and DNA test, which the court of first instance did not permit. Jinhe Company again applies for a DNA test on both. (C) "Jinhe 880" has been approved by the Yunnan Provincial Main Crop Variety Approval Committee and can be promoted. Therefore, Jinhe Company requests the dismissal of Yayu Company's appeal requests.

Ruihe Company, in response to Yayu Company's appeal requests, argued: Ruihe Company should not bear infringement liability. It requests the dismissal of Yayu Company's appeal requests.

Jinhe Company's appeal requests: Reverse the original judgment and instead dismiss all of Yayu Company's claims; the acceptance fees for the first instance and the appeal shall be borne by Yayu Company. Facts and reasons: (A) The court of first instance erred in fact by determining Jinhe Company's sales volume as of March 25, 2021, based on the production and operation filing information for "Jinhe 880" queried from the "China Seed Industry Big Data Platform." First, Jinhe Company entrusted Ruihe Company to make the sales filing. According to the evidence provided by Ruihe Company, the sales volume filed through the online reporting system for seed production and operation permits was 17,925 kg. This filed volume was confirmed by the seed station, is objective and authentic, and has probative force. Second, the settlement statement for corn seed production submitted by Jinhe Company with Xichang Kenfeng Agricultural Technology Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Kenfeng Company) can prove the production volume of "Jinhe 880" in 2020, which is largely consistent with the volume recorded in Ruihe Company's seed sales filing system. Third, the "Jinhe 880" stored in Jinhe Company's warehouse were returned by customers. The court of first instance ignored the quantity of seeds in inventory due to returns, which constitutes an error in fact. Fourth, the filing information provided by Yayu Company was not operated by Jinhe Company or Ruihe Company. The court of first instance did not ascertain the entity that performed the operation. Moreover, there were duplicate filings by other first-level and second-level agents. After March 25, 2021, new filing information still appeared on the platform. This filing information was definitely not done by Jinhe Company or Ruihe Company, and the possibility of malicious filing by Yayu Company cannot be ruled out. (B) The court of first instance erred in fact by determining, based on the record in the "Application Form for Approval of Main Crop Varieties in Yunnan Province" for "Jinhe 880," that the parent YA8201 used for "Jinhe 880" is the authorized variety in question, and by not permitting Jinhe Company's application for DNA testing and DUS testing. In the process of selection and breeding, the breeding experts employed by Jinhe Company only extracted a variant strain of YA8201. It cannot be deemed the same variety simply because the textual description and name are identical. Jinhe Company has the procedural right to apply for an expert evaluation. Only by conducting DNA testing and DUS testing can the truth of the facts be ascertained. (C) The reasons relied upon by the court of first instance for applying punitive damages cannot stand and constitute an error in applying the law. First, "Jinhe 880" was approved by the Yunnan Provincial Crop Variety Approval Committee and may be promoted and sold in accordance with the law. Jinhe Company did not have the qualification for production and operation, so it entrusted Ruihe Company to handle the production and operation sales filing. This is a practice recognized by the agriculture and rural affairs administrative department and is also an industry custom. Second, Jinhe Company and Ruihe Company did not engage in dishonest conduct during the litigation. The alleged infringing act of Ruihe Company has already ceased; applying for an expert evaluation is a procedural right enjoyed by Jinhe Company under the law; reporting Hu Xueai, the legal representative of Yayu Company, for embezzlement of state-owned assets is a citizen's duty and right. (D) The court of first instance's refusal to add the non-party Kenfeng Company as a defendant in this case constitutes a procedural error. Jinhe Company's "Jinhe 880" was produced by the non-party Kenfeng Company, which is supported by evidence on file such as settlement statements and plant quarantine certificates. During the original trial, Jinhe Company submitted the original of Exhibit 1 for verification, but the court of first instance clearly erred by stating in its evaluation of the evidence that there was no original for verification. Ruihe Company's application in the original trial to join Kenfeng Company in the proceedings did not require Yayu Company's consent. If there was infringement, Kenfeng Company, as the producer of the seeds, should bear joint and several liability and is a necessary joint defendant. The people's court should, ex officio, add it to the proceedings, especially since Ruihe Company had already applied. If Yayu Company expressly stated that it waives its claim against Kenfeng Company, it should only be judged that Jinhe Company bears one-third of the liability.

Yayu Company, in response to Jinhe Company's appeal requests, argued: It requests the dismissal of Jinhe Company's appeal requests and supports Yayu Company's appeal requests.

Ruihe Company submitted: It agrees with Jinhe Company's appeal requests.

Yayu Company filed a lawsuit with the court of first instance, which accepted the case on April 14, 2021. Yayu Company's claims: 1. Order Jinhe Company and Ruihe Company to immediately cease the production and sale of corn seeds under the variety name "Jinhe 880"; 2. Order Jinhe Company and Ruihe Company to immediately destroy the propagating material "YA8201" of the corn seeds under the variety name "Jinhe 880"; 3. Order Jinhe Company and Ruihe Company to immediately pay Yayu Company punitive damages of RMB 4,568,970 for infringing the plant variety rights of "YA8201" (calculation method: 30 yuan/kg x 76,149.5 kg x 2, with the kilogram quantity as of March 25, 2021); 4. The litigation costs of this case shall be borne by Jinhe Company and Ruihe Company.

Jinhe Company argued in the original trial: (A) "Jinhe 880" is a variety developed by Jinhe Company through over ten years of cooperation with a research institution after obtaining its business license, and it has been approved by the Yunnan Provincial Crop Variety Approval Committee, making it a lawful variety. The parent "YA8201" of "Jinhe 880" merely shares the same name as the authorized variety in question, "YA8201". Yayu Company has no results from DNA identification or DUS testing to prove that "Jinhe 880" constitutes infringement. (B) The authorized variety in question, "YA8201", was bred by Hu Xueai, the legal representative of Yayu Company, by virtue of his position when he served as the Deputy Director of Ya'an Agricultural Science Research Institute (hereinafter referred to as Ya'an Agricultural Institute). The variety right should belong to Ya'an Agricultural Institute. (C) For "Jinhe 880", Jinhe Company planned to plant 200 mu, actually planted over 100 mu, but after a disaster, the actual yield was only 17,081 kg. Moreover, due to heavy rainfall in 2020, severe ear rot disease, and litigation, 16,900 kg are still stacked in the warehouse. The purchase price of "Jinhe 880" was only 16.85 yuan/kg. Therefore, the sales volume and compensation amount claimed by Yayu Company are baseless. (D) In practice, there may be situations where a filing is made without corresponding stock, or duplicate filings by district, county, or township agents, or returns of unsold seeds by agents after filing. Therefore, the filed quantity cannot be equated with the sales volume. In summary, it requests the people's court to dismiss Yayu Company's claims.

Ruihe Company argued in the original trial: (A) Regarding whether Yayu Company is the holder of the plant variety right for the corn variety "YA8201" and whether "Jinhe 880" uses this "YA8201" as a parent, its views are the same as Jinhe Company's. (B) "Jinhe 880" was actually produced and sold by Kenfeng Company. Kenfeng Company should be added as a joint defendant in this case. (C) Ruihe Company only provided its seed operation filing qualification to Jinhe Company in 2020, charging a fee of RMB 60,000, and did not jointly profit. Before providing its qualification, Ruihe Company verified Jinhe Company's main crop variety approval certificate for "Jinhe 880" and did not constitute a joint infringement. (D) Upon receiving the notice letter, Ruihe Company immediately ceased its cooperation with Jinhe Company and had no intent to infringe. In summary, it requests the people's court to dismiss the claims against Ruihe Company.

The court of first instance found the following facts:

(I) Information on the Parties and Related Seed Information

Yayu Company was established on June 30, 2003, originally named Sichuan Yayu Technology Development Co., Ltd., and changed to its current name on June 22, 2018. Its business scope includes research, development, and services for crop seeds, as well as seed sales. On January 1, 2010, Sichuan Yayu Technology Development Co., Ltd. obtained a plant variety right for "YA8201" with variety right number CNA20060204.7. The filing date for this variety right was March 30, 2006, and the protection period is 15 years.

Jinhe Company was established on April 13, 2009, with a business scope including the sale of seeds (packaged seeds not requiring further repackaging). On May 24, 2019, Jinhe Company obtained the "Main Crop Variety Approval Certificate" with approval number Dian Shen Yu Mi 2019097 issued by the Yunnan Provincial Crop Variety Approval Committee. The certificate records: Approval Number: Dian Shen Yu Mi 2019097; Variety Name: "Jinhe 880"; Variety Source: "Jinhe 880" is a hybrid combination bred by Jinhe Company in 2013 in Yunnan Province using the female parent "LSC107" and the male parent "YA8201"; The applicant and the breeder are both Jinhe Company.

Ruihe Company was established on April 2, 2014, with a business scope including processing, production, packaging, wholesale, and retail of hybrid corn, hybrid seeds, and their parent seeds. On May 31, 2017, the Yunnan Provincial Department of Agriculture issued to Ruihe Company the "Crop Seed Production and Operation Permit (Master Permit)" with number BCD (Dian) Nong Zhong Xu Zi (2014) No. 0016, and issued a duplicate on December 14, 2020. The duplicate listed the crop varieties, including "Jinhe 880".

(II) Alleged Infringing Acts

On April 23, 2021, Yayu Company applied for evidence preservation to the Chengdu Luzheng Notary Office, Sichuan Province. It logged into the official website of the "Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs of the People's Republic of China," entered the "China Seed Industry Big Data Platform," and viewed the details of "Jinhe 880" under the "Variety Approval" column, which displayed the following information: Approval Number: "Dian Shen Yu Mi 2019097"; Crop Name: "Corn"; Applicant and Breeder: both were Jinhe Company; Variety Source: Jinhe Company in 2013 in Yunnan Province using female parent "LSC107" and male parent "YA8201" to prepare the hybrid combination. Returning to the "China Seed Industry Big Data Platform," it viewed the seed production and operation permit information for "Jinhe 880." Clicking on the duplicate certificate, the "Crop Seed Production and Operation Permit" appeared, showing: Enterprise Name: Ruihe Company; Permit Number: BCD (Dian) Nong Zhong Xu Zi (2014) No. 0016. Returning to the "China Seed Industry Big Data Platform," it viewed the variety information chain for "Jinhe 880." Clicking on "Seed Production and Operation Filing," 458 records of production and operation filing details appeared (period from December 30, 2019, to April 19, 2021), including the filing unit, seed quantity (kg), filing date, etc. After counting the seed quantities shown in the 444 records with dates up to March 25, 2021, the total was 76,549.5 kg.

Yayu Company logged into the National Seed Market Monitoring Information Release Platform, which showed the price of "Jinhe 880" seeds in 1 kg/bag specification as RMB 55.

Logging into the official website of the "Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs of the People's Republic of China" again, repeating the notarization and evidence collection procedure described above, under "Production and Operation Filing Details," it could be seen that new filing information for "Jinhe 880" still appeared after March 25, 2021, with the latest filing date being May 27, 2021.

On March 25, 2021, Yayu Company sent a notice letter to Jinhe Company and Ruihe Company, requesting them to contact Yayu Company within three days of receipt to discuss the issue of authorized use of the "YA8201" plant variety; if no contact was made within the above period and use continued, legal liability would be pursued. On April 9, 2021, Ruihe Company replied by letter, stating that upon receiving the notice letter, it immediately interviewed the responsible person of Jinhe Company. It stated that on November 12, 2020, it had signed a "Cooperation Agreement on New Hybrid Corn Varieties" with Jinhe Company, and had verified Jinhe Company's approval certificate, believing that Jinhe Company had obtained the variety rights for "Jinhe 880" and "Jinhe Yu 618" (separate case). Reply: 1. Immediately terminate the performance of the cooperation agreement signed with Jinhe Company, including filing, production, sales, etc.; 2. Ruihe Company has no intention to deliberately or negligently infringe plant variety rights; all legal liability shall be borne by Jinhe Company; Ruihe Company is willing to cooperate with Yayu Company in the investigation and evidence collection needed for rights protection.

(III) Circumstances during the Original Trial

At the trial of first instance, Jinhe Company argued that the parent "YA8201" of "Jinhe 880" had only the same name as the authorized variety "YA8201" and was not the same variety. Accordingly, the court of first instance determined that Jinhe Company bore the burden of proof to show that the two were not the same variety and inquired whether Jinhe Company wished to apply for appraisal. Jinhe Company indicated that it would apply for appraisal and submitted an appraisal application. The court of first instance granted the appraisal application and decided to obtain the relevant seed standard samples from the Seed Management Division of the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs. However, Yayu Company, holding an investigation order, obtained from the Yunnan Provincial Seed Management Station the application form for the approval of main crop varieties in Yunnan Province for "Jinhe 880." The application form clearly stated in the section on variety breeding: the female parent "YA8201" of "Jinhe 880" was bred by Yayu Company and introduced in 2011. (Regarding the description of the parents, the application form contained inconsistent statements—female parent "YA8201" with male parent "LSC107," and male parent "YA8201" with female parent "LSC107." For consistency, the court of first instance hereinafter uses the term "parents.") Jinhe Company and its legal representative both signed and affixed their seals to the variety authenticity commitment letter attached to the application form, stating: "This entity and I know and guarantee the authenticity of the hybrid corn variety 'Jinhe 880' provided, and assume legal liability for any falsehood in authenticity." In light of the above, the court of first instance decided not to grant Jinhe Company's appraisal application and informed Jinhe Company accordingly.

(4) Other relevant facts

On November 2, 2020, Jinhe Company issued an authorization letter authorizing Ruihe Company to produce and operate the corn varieties "Jinhe 880" and "Jinhe Yu 618" bred by Jinhe Company, with specific rights including production, operation, use, marking, and market maintenance of "Jinhe 880" and "Jinhe Yu 618," limited to Yunnan Province, from November 2, 2020 to November 2, 2021. On November 12, 2020, Ruihe Company (as Party A) and Jinhe Company (as Party B) entered into a "Cooperation Agreement on New Hybrid Corn Varieties," stipulating: Party B holds intellectual property rights over "Jinhe 880" and "Jinhe Yu 618"; Party A assists Party B in handling the corresponding production and operation filing procedures and provides Party B with copies of the production and operation license, business license, power of attorney, and other relevant filing materials for seed operation filing; Party B pays Party A a one-time annual variety management fee of RMB 60,000 for the period from November 2, 2020 to November 2, 2021, and bears all expenses for the production, sale, administrative legality, and promotion of the above varieties. Party A, aside from collecting the management fee for the above varieties, does not bear any expenses for them.

Upon logging into the online declaration system for Ruihe Company's seed production and operation license, a search for "Jinhe 880" showed a total of 36 entries filed from January 13, 2020 to March 25, 2021, with a filed seed quantity of 17,925 kg. Upon comparison with the data from the China Seed Industry Big Data Platform submitted by Yayu Company, except for two entries marked with "withdraw" in the "operation" column, the remaining 34 entries completely matched the data on the China Seed Industry Big Data Platform.

According to photos submitted by Jinhe Company after the trial, a large quantity of "Jinhe 880" seeds remained stored in its warehouse.

Yayu Company filed two lawsuits jointly against Jinhe Company and Ruihe Company: the present case concerning "Jinhe 880" and Case No. (2021) Yun 01 Zhi Min Chu 136 concerning "Jinhe Yu 618."

The court of first instance held: Yayu Company is the variety rights holder of the new plant variety "YA8201" (CNA20060204.7) and enjoys new plant variety rights over that variety, which remains within the term of validity. Therefore, Yayu Company has the right to bring this lawsuit. Jinhe Company argued that the variety rights should belong to Ya'an Agricultural Science Institute, but provided no sufficient reason or valid evidence, and the authorized status of the variety rights is stable. Hence, the court of first instance declined to accept Jinhe Company's argument.

Regarding the finding of infringement: First, the variety approval information for "Jinhe 880" indicates that "Jinhe 880" was bred using "YA8201," over which Yayu Company holds new plant variety rights. In light of this, the court of first instance denied Jinhe Company's applications for DNA testing and DUS testing. In this case, Jinhe Company not only used "YA8201" to breed "Jinhe 880" but also, from 2019 onward, continuously used "YA8201" for commercial purposes to produce and sell "Jinhe 880." Pursuant to Article 2, paragraphs 1 and 3 of the "Several Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on the Application of Law in Hearing Cases concerning Disputes over Infringement of New Plant Variety Rights," Jinhe Company's acts of producing and selling "Jinhe 880" using "YA8201" as a parent should be found to infringe Yayu Company's new plant variety rights. Second, during Jinhe Company's production and sale of "Jinhe 880," Ruihe Company lent its "Crop Seed Production and Operation License" to Jinhe Company, thereby essentially assisting Jinhe Company's infringement, constituting contributory infringement. Ruihe Company argued that it had fulfilled its duty of review, but China implements a seed production and operation license system; the act of lending the license itself constitutes fault. Moreover, the variety approval information for "Jinhe 880" explicitly states that its parents include "YA8201," and the variety rights information for "YA8201" can be ascertained from public sources. Thus, Ruihe Company did not fulfill its duty of review. Third, as to Ruihe Company's application to add Kenfeng Company as a co-defendant, this is an infringement lawsuit filed by Yayu Company, and Yayu Company does not consent to asserting claims against Kenfeng Company. Whether Kenfeng Company joins the litigation does not affect the resolution of this case, and there is no evidence or reason to indicate that Kenfeng Company is a necessary party. Therefore, the court of first instance denied Ruihe Company's application for joinder.

Regarding liability: First, the request by Yayu Company that Jinhe Company and Ruihe Company immediately cease producing and selling "Jinhe 880" corn seeds and immediately destroy the reproductive material "YA8201" used for "Jinhe 880" is supported. Second, regarding damages: (1) As to the quantity of "Jinhe 880" produced and sold, according to the data recorded on the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs Seed Industry Big Data Platform, from December 30, 2019 to March 25, 2021, the filed quantity of production and operation of "Jinhe 880" was 76,549.5 kg. Yayu Company claimed only 76,149.5 kg, which the court of first instance allowed. (2) As to the profit for "Jinhe 880," the evidence in the case shows that the market price of "Jinhe 880" is RMB 55 per kg. Additionally, Jinhe Company is the primary seller of "Jinhe 880," i.e., the original wholesaler. Generally, wholesale prices are lower than retail prices. Yayu Company's claim that the wholesale price of "Jinhe 880" is RMB 30 per kg is reasonable and is confirmed by the court of first instance. Considering that Jinhe Company needs to provide parent seeds, entrust farmers to produce, and bear operating expenses such as transportation and labor, the court of first instance determines the total cost at RMB 20 per kg. (3) As to the contribution rate of "YA8201" in breeding "Jinhe 880," according to the "Guiding Opinions on Income Distribution of Corn Breeding Achievements," the income distribution ratios for the male parent holder, female parent holder, and combiner are 3:3:4. The court of first instance finds that the contribution rate of "YA8201" for breeding "Jinhe 880" should be 30%. In summary, the profit obtained by Jinhe Company is calculated as: 76,149.5 kg x (RMB 30 - RMB 20)/kg x 30% = RMB 228,448.5. Accordingly, Jinhe Company shall compensate Yayu Company RMB 228,448.5 for infringement losses. Third, regarding punitive damages: Pursuant to Article 1185 of the Civil Code of the People's Republic of China, Article 4, paragraph 2, items (5) and (7) of the "Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on the Application of Punitive Damages in Civil Cases concerning Infringement of Intellectual Property Rights," and Article 17, paragraph 1 of the "Several Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on the Application of Law in Hearing Cases concerning Disputes over Infringement of New Plant Variety Rights (II)," considering that Jinhe Company borrowed Ruihe Company's crop seed production and operation license, continuously produced and sold "Jinhe 880" in large quantities, with nearly 80,000 kg filed on the China Seed Industry Big Data Platform alone since 2019, and that Jinhe Company also acted in bad faith during the litigation, punitive damages should apply to Jinhe Company. Pursuant to Article 17, paragraph 2 of the same interpretation, the mere fact that Jinhe Company borrowed the crop seed production and operation license warrants punitive damages at a multiplier of two or more. However, since Yayu Company only claimed an additional one-fold punitive damages beyond the compensation base, which does not violate the law, it is allowed. Therefore, the court of first instance takes the confirmed amount of infringement profit, RMB 228,448.5, as the base and applies one-fold punitive damages against Jinhe Company. Thus, in addition to paying the infringement loss of RMB 228,448.5, Jinhe Company shall also pay punitive damages of RMB 228,448.5. Finally, Ruihe Company constitutes contributory infringement. Pursuant to Article 1169 of the Civil Code of the People's Republic of China, Ruihe Company shall bear joint and several liability for the above infringement losses and punitive damages payable by Jinhe Company. As for the supplementary agreement between Ruihe Company and Jinhe Company, it is an internal arrangement and the parties may address it separately.

The court of first instance, in accordance with Article 1169 and Article 1185 of the Civil Code of the People's Republic of China, Article 28, Article 33, paragraph 3, Article 73, paragraph 3, and Article 77, paragraph 1, item (4) of the Seed Law of the People's Republic of China, Article 1, paragraph 3 and Article 24 of the "Several Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on the Application of Temporal Effect of the Civil Code of the People's Republic of China," Article 2, paragraphs 1 and 3 and Article 6, paragraphs 1, 2, and 4 of the "Several Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on the Application of Law in Hearing Cases concerning Disputes over Infringement of New Plant Variety Rights," Article 6 and Article 17, paragraph 1, item (5) and paragraph 2 of the "Several Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on the Application of Law in Hearing Cases concerning Disputes over Infringement of New Plant Variety Rights (II)," and Article 4, paragraph 2, items (5) and (7) and Article 5, paragraph 1 of the "Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on the Application of Punitive Damages in Civil Cases concerning Infringement of Intellectual Property Rights," entered the following judgment: 1. Yunnan Jinhe Seed Co., Ltd. and Yunnan Ruihe Seed Co., Ltd. shall immediately cease producing and selling corn seeds under the variety name "Jinhe 880" from the effective date of the judgment; 2. Upon review, this court finds that the alleged infringing act in this case is Jinhe Company's production and sale of "Jinhe 880" by borrowing Ruihe Company's seed production and operation license up to March 25, 2021. Dingcheng Company's actions may prove whether Jinhe Company continued to use "YA8201" for commercial purposes to produce and sell "Jinhe 880" corn seeds after the first-instance judgment, which is relevant to determining Jinhe Company's subjective state.

The facts found by the court of first instance are substantially true, and this court confirms them.

During the second instance, Jinhe Company repeatedly and clearly stated to this court: As a hybrid corn variety, each time the reproductive material of "Jinhe 880" is obtained, "YA8201" must be used.

Jinhe Company insisted that it used a mutant of "YA8201." At the request of this court, Jinhe Company explained the specific breeding process of the alleged mutant of "YA8201" and applied for a DNA test on the male parent of "Jinhe 880" and Yayu Company's "YA8201" to prove that they are not identical. Regarding the source of DNA fingerprint information for the parents of "Jinhe 880," Jinhe Company stated that when applying to the Yunnan Provincial Crop Variety Approval Committee for approval of the main crop variety, it submitted the parent information. This court, ex officio, sent an inquiry letter to the Office of the Yunnan Provincial Crop Variety Approval Committee regarding the breeding source of "Jinhe 880" and received a reply. The reply stated that when "Jinhe 880" (Approval No.: Dian Shen Corn 2019097) was submitted for approval, the applicant did not submit the DNA fingerprint information of the male and female parents or standard seed samples of the parents. This court informed Jinhe Company of the reply and asked whether it could submit other control samples for comparison. Jinhe Company replied that it could not submit other control samples for testing. Regarding Jinhe Company's above application for appraisal, this court holds that, pursuant to Article 121, paragraph 1 of the "Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on the Application of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China," a party may apply for appraisal before the expiration of the evidence submission period. If the matter to be appraised is irrelevant to the facts to be proved or of no significance in proving such facts, the people's court shall not grant the application. According to the reply from the Office of the Yunnan Provincial Crop Variety Approval Committee, the applicant did not submit DNA fingerprint information or standard samples of the male and female parents when applying for approval of the "Jinhe 880" corn variety. Due to the lack of reliable control samples or DNA fingerprint information, it is impossible to determine through appraisal the identity of the male parent of "Jinhe 880" and Yayu Company's "YA8201." The matter for which Jinhe Company applied for appraisal is not practically feasible for appraisal. Therefore, Jinhe Company's appraisal application is not feasible, and this court does not grant it.

During the first instance, to prove that the parent repeatedly used for producing and reproducing "Jinhe 880" was not the authorized variety "YA8201," Jinhe Company applied to the court of first instance for DNA testing and DUS testing. Upon review, during the first instance, Jinhe Company did not explain the specific breeding process of the alleged mutant and failed to sufficiently demonstrate the reason for initiating the appraisal. Moreover, when applying for approval of the main crop variety in Yunnan Province, it had already indicated that "Jinhe 880" was bred using Yayu Company's "YA8201" as a parent. Under these circumstances, the court of first instance did not err in denying the appraisal application.

This court additionally finds: The female parent "LSC107" recorded in the variety approval certificate for "Jinhe 880" is also protected by variety rights.

This court holds that the alleged infringing act in this case occurred before March 1, 2022, the effective date of the Seed Law of the People's Republic of China (as amended in 2021), and after January 1, 2016, the effective date of the Seed Law of the People's Republic of China (as revised in 2015). Therefore, this case shall apply the relevant provisions of the Seed Law (2015 revision) and other relevant laws. According to the parties' claims and defenses, the issues in this second-instance stage are: (1) Whether Jinhe Company and Ruihe Company constitute infringement; (2) If infringement is established, how to determine the amount of damages; (3) Whether there were procedural issues in the first instance.

(1) Whether Jinhe Company and Ruihe Company constitute infringement

根据《中华人民共和国种子法》第二十八条规定，植物新品种权所有人对其授权品种享有排他的独占权；除另有规定外，任何单位或者个人未经植物新品种权所有人许可，不得为商业目的将授权品种的繁殖材料重复使用于生产另一品种的繁殖材料。根据金禾公司在云南省申请品种审定时提交的申请表，“金禾880”是以雅玉公司的“YA8201”为亲本选育的。二审审理期间，金禾公司明确向本院陈述：作为玉米杂交品种，每一次获得“金禾880”的繁殖材料都需要使用“YA8201”。根据上述事实可以认定金禾公司为商业目的将“YA8201”重复使用于生产“金禾880”，构成对涉案授权品种“YA8201”的品种权的侵害。金禾公司抗辩其使用的是“YA8201”的变异株，并向本院申请进行DNA鉴定，但由于其不能提交对照样本导致鉴定不具备可行性，金禾公司对仅使用了“YA8201”的变异株的主张，未能提交有效证据证明，本院对该主张不予采信。本案中，瑞禾公司出借其种子生产经营许可证，供不具备种子生产经营资质的金禾公司从事种子生产经营活动，并从中获利，为金禾公司实施侵权行为提供帮助，根据《中华人民共和国民法典》第一千一百六十九条第一款规定，构成帮助侵权。据此，原审法院考虑制止侵权，判令金禾公司、瑞禾公司立即停止生产、销售“金禾880”玉米种子，以及立即销毁重复用于繁殖“金禾880”玉米种子的“YA8201”的繁殖材料，并无不当，本院予以维持。原审法院在侵权责任承担部分的分析以及判项中将“YA8201”称为“金禾880”的繁殖材料，但“YA8201”系“金禾880”的亲本，不能将杂交品种的亲本称为杂交品种的繁殖材料，本院对此予以纠正。

According to Article 28 of the Seed Law of the People's Republic of China, the owner of a new plant variety right enjoys an exclusive right to its authorized variety; unless otherwise provided, no entity or individual may, without the permission of the owner of the new plant variety right, repeatedly use the reproductive material of the authorized variety for the purpose of producing the reproductive material of another variety for commercial purposes. According to the application form submitted by Jinhe Company when applying for variety approval in Yunnan Province, "Jinhe 880" was bred using Yayu Company's "YA8201" as a parent. During the second instance trial, Jinhe Company clearly stated to this Court: as a hybrid corn variety, each time the reproductive material of "Jinhe 880" is obtained, "YA8201" must be used. Based on the above facts, it can be determined that Jinhe Company repeatedly used "YA8201" for the production of "Jinhe 880" for commercial purposes, constituting an infringement of the variety right of the authorized variety "YA8201" involved in the case. Jinhe Company argued in defense that it used a variant strain of "YA8201" and applied to this Court for DNA testing. However, because it could not submit a control sample, the testing was not feasible. Jinhe Company failed to submit effective evidence to prove its claim that it only used a variant strain of "YA8201", and this Court does not accept that claim. In this case, Ruihe Company lent its seed production and operation license to Jinhe Company, which did not have the qualifications for seed production and operation, to engage in seed production and operation activities and profited from it, providing assistance to Jinhe Company in committing the infringing act. According to Article 1169, paragraph 1, of the Civil Code of the People's Republic of China, this constitutes contributory infringement. Accordingly, the court of first instance, considering the need to stop the infringement, ordered Jinhe Company and Ruihe Company to immediately cease the production and sale of "Jinhe 880" corn seeds and immediately destroy the reproductive material of "YA8201" repeatedly used for propagating "Jinhe 880" corn seeds. This was not improper, and this Court upholds it. In the analysis of the liability for infringement and the judgment items, the court of first instance referred to "YA8201" as the reproductive material of "Jinhe 880". However, "YA8201" is the parent of "Jinhe 880", and the parent of a hybrid variety cannot be called the reproductive material of the hybrid variety. This Court corrects this.

（二）如何确定赔偿数额

(2) How to Determine the Amount of Compensation

根据《中华人民共和国种子法》第七十三条第三款规定，侵犯植物新品种权的赔偿数额按照权利人因被侵权所受到的实际损失确定；实际损失难以确定的，可以按照侵权人因侵权所获得的利益确定。权利人的损失或者侵权人获得的利益难以确定的，可以参照该植物新品种权许可使用费的倍数合理确定。赔偿数额应当包括权利人为制止侵权行为所支付的合理开支。侵犯植物新品种权，情节严重的，可以在按照上述方法确定数额的一倍以上三倍以下确定赔偿数额。雅玉公司主张侵权人因侵权所获得的利益，并适用一倍的惩罚性赔偿，本案中需要考察是否符合适用惩罚性赔偿的条件，并确定惩罚性赔偿的基数。

According to Article 73, paragraph 3, of the Seed Law of the People's Republic of China, the amount of compensation for infringement of a new plant variety right shall be determined based on the actual losses suffered by the right holder due to the infringement. If the actual losses are difficult to determine, the amount may be determined based on the profits gained by the infringer from the infringement. If the losses of the right holder or the profits gained by the infringer are difficult to determine, the amount may be reasonably determined by reference to a multiple of the licensing fee for the use of the new plant variety right. The amount of compensation shall include the reasonable expenses incurred by the right holder to stop the infringement. Where the infringement of a new plant variety right is of a serious nature, the amount of compensation may be determined at between one and three times the amount determined according to the above methods. Yayu Company claims the profits gained by the infringer from the infringement and applies a punitive damages multiplier of one time. In this case, it is necessary to examine whether the conditions for applying punitive damages are met and to determine the base amount for punitive damages.

1.关于惩罚性赔偿的适用

1. Regarding the Application of Punitive Damages

根据《中华人民共和国种子法》第七十三条第三款规定，侵犯植物新品种权，情节严重的，可以适用惩罚性赔偿。根据《中华人民共和国种子法》第三十三条第三款、第七十七条第一款第四项，《最高人民法院关于审理侵害植物新品种权纠纷案件具体应用法律问题的若干规定（二）》第十七条第一款第五项规定，伪造、变造、买卖、租借种子生产经营许可证的，可以认定为侵权行为情节严重。依据上述规定，本案中对金禾公司是否适用惩罚性赔偿可以从如下方面考虑：品种权授权信息要经过公告向社会公众公开，金禾公司使用雅玉公司的“YA8201”作为亲本组配“金禾880”杂交玉米品种，“金禾880”在云南省进行主要农作物品种审定时申请表中写明亲本“YA8201”由雅玉公司选育，于2011年引入。通过上述事实可以认定金禾公司明知“YA8201”为雅玉公司享有品种权的植物新品种，未经品种权人许可仍然为商业目的重复使用“YA8201”生产“金禾880”的繁殖材料。金禾公司抗辩其借用瑞禾公司的种子生产经营许可证是行业内通常做法。但是，我国为保障主要农作物用种安全，对于从事种子生产经营活动设置市场准入制度，借用种子生产经营许可证使得不具备与种子生产经营相适应的生产条件的企业进入种子市场，扰乱了种子市场秩序，明确为种子法所禁止。金禾公司借用瑞禾公司的种子生产经营许可证生产经营“金禾880”，向瑞禾公司支付管理费，属于上述规定所指的“租借种子生产经营许可证”的行为，构成侵权行为情节严重。本案中对金禾公司依法可以适用惩罚性赔偿，本院对于雅玉公司主张适用一倍惩罚性赔偿的请求予以支持。原审法院考虑该情节适用惩罚性赔偿，并无不当，本院予以维持。

According to Article 73, paragraph 3, of the Seed Law of the People's Republic of China, if the infringement of a new plant variety right is of a serious nature, punitive damages may be applied. According to Article 33, paragraph 3, and Article 77, paragraph 1, item 4, of the Seed Law of the People's Republic of China, and Article 17, paragraph 1, item 5, of the Several Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on the Specific Application of Law in the Trial of Disputes over Infringement of New Plant Variety Rights (II), forging, altering, buying, selling, or lending a seed production and operation license may be deemed as a serious circumstance of the infringing act. Based on the above provisions, whether punitive damages should be applied to Jinhe Company in this case can be considered from the following aspects: Information on the authorization of the variety right is publicized through announcements to the public. Jinhe Company used Yayu Company's "YA8201" as a parent to assemble the "Jinhe 880" hybrid corn variety. In the application form for "Jinhe 880" for the approval of major crop varieties in Yunnan Province, it was stated that the parent "YA8201" was bred by Yayu Company and introduced in 2011. Based on the above facts, it can be determined that Jinhe Company knew that "YA8201" was a new plant variety for which Yayu Company held the variety right, yet without the permission of the right holder, it still repeatedly used "YA8201" for the commercial purpose of producing the reproductive material of "Jinhe 880". Jinhe Company argued in defense that borrowing Ruihe Company's seed production and operation license was a common practice in the industry. However, to ensure the safety of seeds for major crops, China has established a market access system for seed production and operation activities. Lending a seed production and operation license allows enterprises that do not have the production conditions suitable for seed production and operation to enter the seed market, disrupting the order of the seed market, and is expressly prohibited by the Seed Law. Jinhe Company borrowed Ruihe Company's seed production and operation license to produce and operate "Jinhe 880" and paid management fees to Ruihe Company. This constitutes the act of "lending a seed production and operation license" as referred to in the above provisions and constitutes a serious circumstance of the infringing act. In this case, punitive damages may legally be applied to Jinhe Company. This Court supports Yayu Company's request for the application of a one-time multiplier of punitive damages. The court of first instance considered this circumstance and applied punitive damages, which was not improper, and this Court upholds it.

（1）关于“金禾880”的销售数量和销售价格

(1) Regarding the Sales Volume and Sales Price of "Jinhe 880"

雅玉公司提供了“中国种业大数据平台”中“金禾880”自2019年12月30日至2021年3月25日期间的备案信息，原审法院以上述备案信息为依据，并考虑雅玉公司在本案中主张的数量少于上述备案数量，从而认定“金禾880”的生产经营数量为76 149.5公斤，并无不当。金禾公司对于上述数据提出异议，认为存在多级销售商重复备案，不排除雅玉公司恶意备案的可能，并且因为存在退货实际销售数量少于备案数量。瑞禾公司原审中提交了其种子生产经营许可网上申报系统中2020年1月13日至2021年3月25日期间的36条备案信息。经审查，雅玉公司提交的备案信息起始时间早于瑞禾公司的数据，其中部分重合备案主体涉及的备案信息相同，可以佐证雅玉公司提交的备案信息的真实性。同时，2019年修订的《农作物种子生产经营许可管理办法》第二十三条规定，专门经营不再分装的包装种子或者受具有种子生产经营许可证的企业书面委托代销其种子的，应当在种子销售前向当地县级农业主管部门备案。备案时应当提交种子销售者的营业执照复印件、种子购销凭证或委托代销合同复印件等材料。金禾公司认为存在雅玉公司进行恶意备案的可能，但是进行种子销售备案时需要提交上述规定的材料，金禾公司的主张属于其推断，没有证据加以证明，不能成立。此外，金禾公司主张因存在退货实际销售数量少于备案数量，存在多级代理商重复备案的情况，但金禾公司作为实际生产经营者应掌握详细的销售台账，其未能提供自己掌握的财务账簿等证据证明上述事实，应承担举证不能的不利后果，本院对金禾公司的上述主张不予采信。综上，金禾公司主张原审判决认定的销售数量错误，证据不足，本院不予采信。在确定销售数量的基础上，原审法院确定“金禾880”的批发价格为每公斤30元，双方二审中均未对此提出异议，本院予以确认。通过上述销售数量和价格可以计算出，截至2021年3月25日，金禾公司生产、销售“金禾880”所得的销售收入为2 284 485元。

Yayu Company provided filing information for "Jinhe 880" from December 30, 2019, to March 25, 2021, from the "China Seed Industry Big Data Platform". The court of first instance relied on the above filing information and, considering that the quantity claimed by Yayu Company in this case was less than the above filed quantity, determined that the production and operation quantity of "Jinhe 880" was 76,149.5 kilograms, which was not improper. Jinhe Company objected to the above data, arguing that there was duplicate filing by multiple levels of distributors, that the possibility of malicious filing by Yayu Company could not be ruled out, and that due to returns, the actual sales volume was less than the filed volume. During the first instance, Ruihe Company submitted 36 records of filing information from January 13, 2020, to March 25, 2021, from its online reporting system for seed production and operation licenses. Upon review, the filing information submitted by Yayu Company had an earlier start date than Ruihe Company's data, and some of the overlapping filing entities involved identical filing information, which corroborated the authenticity of the filing information submitted by Yayu Company. Furthermore, Article 23 of the Measures for the Administration of Crop Seed Production and Operation Licenses (revised in 2019) provides that entities specialized in dealing in packaged seeds that are not further repackaged or entrusted in writing by an enterprise holding a seed production and operation license to sell its seeds on a commission basis shall file with the local county-level agricultural competent authority before the sale of seeds. When filing, they shall submit copies of the seed seller's business license, seed purchase and sale vouchers or copies of the commission sales contract, and other materials. Jinhe Company argued that there was a possibility of malicious filing by Yayu Company. However, the above-mentioned materials are required to be submitted when filing for seed sales. Jinhe Company's claim is an inference without evidence to prove it and cannot be established. Additionally, Jinhe Company argued that due to returns, the actual sales volume was less than the filed volume, and there was duplicate filing by multiple levels of agents. However, as the actual producer and operator, Jinhe Company should have detailed sales ledgers. It failed to provide evidence such as its own financial account books to prove the above facts and should bear the adverse consequences of failing to present evidence. This Court does not accept Jinhe Company's above claim. In summary, Jinhe Company's claim that the sales volume determined by the first instance judgment was erroneous lacks sufficient evidence, and this Court does not accept it. Based on the determination of the sales volume, the court of first instance determined the wholesale price of "Jinhe 880" at RMB 30 per kilogram. Neither party raised any objection to this during the second instance, and this Court confirms it. Based on the above sales volume and price, it can be calculated that, as of March 25, 2021, Jinhe Company's sales revenue from producing and selling "Jinhe 880" was RMB 2,284,485.

（2）关于金禾公司生产经营“金禾880”的利润

(2) Regarding the Profits of Jinhe Company from Producing and Operating "Jinhe 880"

在按照侵权获利确定惩罚性赔偿基数时，应考虑侵权人生产经营侵权种子的营业利润，营业利润可以采取销售收入减去销售成本及增值税税金，再减去销售费用、管理费用和财务费用的方式计算；单一类别产品的销售收入和营业利润率可以确定时，营业利润也可以直接以该产品的销售收入乘以营业利润率确定。本案中，在雅玉公司请求以侵权获利确定赔偿数额的情况下，金禾公司未提供证据证明“金禾880”的营业利润或企业的营业利润率等与计算公式相关的数据。特别是，本院在二审期间要求金禾公司提供被诉侵权行为发生期间企业财务会计报表，其以公司没有规范运作为由向本院表示无法提供。依据《最高人民法院关于知识产权民事诉讼证据的若干规定》第二十五条第一款、《最高人民法院关于审理侵害知识产权民事案件适用惩罚性赔偿的解释》第五条第三款规定，金禾公司上述消极执行法院命令、拒不提供自己掌握的相应证据材料的行为，已经构成举证妨碍，导致本院既无法获取金禾公司生产、销售“金禾880”的营业利润，也无法获取金禾公司的整体营业利润率作为“金禾880”的利润率的参考，本院依法以品种权人主张的成本作为计算数据。雅玉公司主张玉米制种的成本为每公斤8-12元，本院取中间数，确定金禾公司的成本为每公斤10元，据此金禾公司生产经营“金禾880”的利润为每公斤20元。同时考虑上述“金禾880”的销售收入，可以计算出金禾公司涉案行为产生的营业利润为1 522 990元。雅玉公司主张品种权侵权案件中的“侵权获利”不应考虑经营成本，应当按照销售价格乘以销售数量。经审查，在没有证据证明金禾公司构成以侵权为业的情况下，上述主张与《中华人民共和国种子法》第七十三条关于侵权获利的规定不符，本院不予采信。

When determining the base amount for punitive damages based on profits from infringement, consideration should be given to the operating profits of the infringer from producing and operating the infringing seeds. Operating profits can be calculated by subtracting the cost of sales and value-added tax from sales revenue, and then subtracting selling expenses, administrative expenses, and financial expenses. When the sales revenue and operating profit margin of a single category of product can be determined, the operating profit can also be directly determined by multiplying the sales revenue of that product by the operating profit margin. In this case, where Yayu Company requested that the amount of compensation be determined based on profits from infringement, Jinhe Company failed to provide evidence proving the operating profit of "Jinhe 880" or the enterprise's operating profit margin or other data related to the calculation formula. In particular, during the second instance, this Court requested Jinhe Company to provide the enterprise's financial accounting statements for the period of the alleged infringement. Jinhe Company stated to this Court that it could not provide them because the company was not operating in a standardized manner. According to Article 25, paragraph 1, of the Several Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Evidence in Civil Actions Involving Intellectual Property Rights and Article 5, paragraph 3, of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on the Application of Punitive Damages in the Trial of Civil Cases Involving Infringement of Intellectual Property Rights, Jinhe Company's above-mentioned passive compliance with the court's order and refusal to provide the corresponding evidence materials in its possession constitutes a hindrance to the production of evidence. This has made it impossible for this Court to obtain either the operating profit of Jinhe Company from producing and selling "Jinhe 880" or Jinhe Company's overall operating profit margin as a reference for the profit margin of "Jinhe 880". This Court legally uses the cost claimed by the variety right holder as the basis for calculation. Yayu Company claimed that the cost of corn seed production was RMB 8-12 per kilogram. This Court takes the midpoint and determines Jinhe Company's cost to be RMB 10 per kilogram. Accordingly, Jinhe Company's profit from producing and operating "Jinhe 880" is RMB 20 per kilogram. Considering the above-mentioned sales revenue of "Jinhe 880", it can be calculated that the operating profit generated by Jinhe Company's acts in this case is RMB 1,522,990. Yayu Company argued that in cases of infringement of variety rights, the "profits from infringement" should not consider operating costs and should be based on the sales price multiplied by the sales volume. Upon review, in the absence of evidence proving that Jinhe Company's business is primarily infringement, the above claim is inconsistent with the provisions of Article 73 of the Seed Law of the People's Republic of China regarding profits from infringement, and this Court does not accept it.

（3）关于品种权的贡献率

(3) Regarding the Contribution Rate of the Variety Right

“金禾880”为玉米杂交品种，其他亲本的持有者对于该品种的培育也作出了一定贡献。经审查，“金禾880”的母本“LSC107”也受品种权保护，考虑本案情况，本院确定“YA8201”对于“金禾880”玉米杂交品种的贡献率为50%。

"Jinhe 880" is a hybrid corn variety, and the holder of the other parent also made certain contributions to the breeding of this variety. Upon review, the female parent of "Jinhe 880", "LSC107", is also protected by a variety right. Considering the circumstances of this case, this Court determines that the contribution rate of "YA8201" to the "Jinhe 880" hybrid corn variety is 50%.

综合上述“金禾880”的销售数量和销售价格、金禾公司生产经营“金禾880”的利润、品种权的贡献率三方面的分析，考虑种业大数据平台自2019年12月30日至2021年3月25日期间“金禾880”的备案数量并结合雅玉公司的主张，可以计算出上述期间金禾公司生产经营“金禾880”产生的销售收入。金禾公司拒不提交其掌握的相应账簿及财务资料，导致无法计算金禾公司上述期间生产、销售“金禾880”的营业利润，构成举证妨碍，应承担举证妨碍的相应后果，本院按照雅玉公司的主张确定“金禾880”的利润为每公斤20元。在此基础上，考虑雅玉公司“YA8201”品种权对“金禾880”的贡献率，可以计算出金禾公司截止到2021年3月25日因生产经营的“金禾880”侵害雅玉公司“YA8201”品种权的侵权获利为761 495元。金禾公司应就上述侵权获利向雅玉公司承担赔偿责任。除此以外，金禾公司还应支付一倍的惩罚性赔偿金，共计赔偿雅玉公司1 522 990元。瑞禾公司作为帮助侵权人，对上述赔偿负连带责任。雅玉公司关于赔偿数额的部分上诉请求成立，本院予以支持。原审判决关于赔偿数额的计算有所不当，本院予以纠正。

Based on the comprehensive analysis of the sales volume and sales price of "Jinhe 880", the profits of Jinhe Company from producing and operating "Jinhe 880", and the contribution rate of the variety right, considering the filing quantity of "Jinhe 880" recorded on the Seed Industry Big Data Platform from December 30, 2019, to March 25, 2021, and in conjunction with Yayu Company's claims, it can be calculated that the sales revenue generated by Jinhe Company from producing and operating "Jinhe 880" during the above period. Jinhe Company refused to submit the corresponding account books and financial materials in its possession, making it impossible to calculate the operating profit of Jinhe Company from producing and selling "Jinhe 880" during the above period. This constitutes a hindrance to the production of evidence, and Jinhe Company shall bear the corresponding consequences. This Court determines the profit of "Jinhe 880" to be RMB 20 per kilogram based on Yayu Company's claim. On this basis, considering the contribution rate of Yayu Company's "YA8201" variety right to "Jinhe 880", it can be calculated that as of March 25, 2021, Jinhe Company's profits from infringement of Yayu Company's "YA8201" variety right through the production and operation of "Jinhe 880" are RMB 761,495. Jinhe Company shall be liable for compensation to Yayu Company for the above profits from infringement. In addition, Jinhe Company shall also pay punitive damages of one time, totaling compensation of RMB 1,522,990 to Yayu Company. Ruihe Company, as a contributory infringer, shall bear joint and several liability for the above compensation. Yayu Company's partial appeal request regarding the amount of compensation is established, and this Court supports it. The calculation of the compensation amount in the first instance judgment was somewhat improper, and this Court corrects it.

金禾公司在本案的侵权认定和赔偿数额确定中都提出抗辩称“金禾880”已经在云南省通过主要农作物审定，金禾公司在组配“金禾880”的过程中付出了大量时间，投入了大量劳动。经审查，“金禾880”于2019年在云南省通过主要农作物品种审定。主要农作物品种审定制度作为种子市场准入的行政管理制度，可以加速育种新成果的推广利用，确保有经济推广价值的品种进入市场。品种权保护与品种审定是两种不同的制度，是否构成侵害植物新品种权，仍要依据种子法的规定进行审查。从事种子生产经营的育种企业要注意尊重他人品种权。对于他人享有品种权的植物新品种繁殖材料，为育种活动和品种审定目的的使用行为可以豁免侵权责任，但为商业目的重复使用于生产繁殖另一品种的繁殖材料时需要经过品种权人许可，否则构成侵害他人品种权的侵权行为。保护品种权和确保有经济价值的作物品种进入市场两者之间相辅相成，只有尊重品种权，才能推动更多有价值的作物进入种子市场，为种业科技创新提供持续动力，促进种业科技自立自强。

In both the determination of infringement and the calculation of the compensation amount in this case, Jinhe Company argued in defense that "Jinhe 880" had passed the approval for major crops in Yunnan Province and that Jinhe Company had invested a significant amount of time and labor in the process of assembling "Jinhe 880". Upon review, "Jinhe 880" passed the approval for major crop varieties in Yunnan Province in 2019. The approval system for major crop varieties, as an administrative market access system for seeds, can accelerate the promotion and utilization of new breeding achievements and ensure that varieties with economic promotion value enter the market. Variety right protection and variety approval are two different systems. Whether an act constitutes infringement of a new plant variety right must still be examined in accordance with the provisions of the Seed Law. Breeding enterprises engaged in seed production and operation should pay attention to respecting the variety rights of others. For the reproductive material of a new plant variety for which others hold a variety right, use for the purpose of breeding activities and variety approval may be exempted from infringement liability. However, repeated use for the commercial purpose of producing the reproductive material of another variety requires the permission of the variety right holder; otherwise, it constitutes an infringement of others' variety rights. Protecting variety rights and ensuring that economically valuable crop varieties enter the market are complementary. Only by respecting variety rights can more valuable crops be promoted into the seed market, providing sustained impetus for technological innovation in the seed industry and promoting self-reliance and self-strengthening in seed science and technology.

（三）原审是否存在程序问题

(3) Whether There Were Procedural Issues in the First Instance

关于瑞禾公司原审期间申请追加垦丰公司为共同被告的问题，由于雅玉公司作为品种权人明确表示不同意追加，原审法院出于尊重原告诉权的考虑，对瑞禾公司的申请不予准许，并无不当，本院予以维持。即使如瑞禾公司所称，垦丰公司作为“金禾880”的实际生产者，为共同侵权人，本案也并非必要的共同诉讼，雅玉公司有权选择对共同侵权中的全部或部分侵权人主张权利，并不影响共同侵权的各行为人单独就全部债务对外承担责任。因此，瑞禾公司以此为由认为原审存在程序问题，不能成立，本院不予支持。

Regarding the issue of Ruihe Company applying during the first instance to add Kenfeng Company as a co-defendant, since Yayu Company, as the variety right holder, expressly stated that it did not agree to the addition, the court of first instance, out of respect for the plaintiff's right of action, did not permit Ruihe Company's application. This was not improper, and this Court upholds it. Even if, as Ruihe Company claims, Kenfeng Company, as the actual producer of "Jinhe 880", is a joint infringer, this case is not a necessary joint action. Yayu Company has the right to choose to assert its rights against all or part of the joint infringers, and this does not affect the individual liability of each joint infringer to be jointly and severally liable for the entire debt. Therefore, Ruihe Company's argument that the first instance had procedural issues on this basis cannot be established, and this Court does not support it.

关于金禾公司原审时提交的证据1，为垦丰公司出具的结算单。经审查，原审法院对该份证据的认证不仅考虑了证据形式，而且结合金禾公司提交的其他证据中所记载的向案外人销售“金禾880”的时间和数量，进行综合分析。在综合分析的基础上，原审法院对该份证据的证明力不予采信，并无不当。

Regarding Evidence 1 submitted by Jinhe Company during the first instance, which was a settlement statement issued by Kenfeng Company. Upon review, the court of first instance's authentication of this evidence not only considered the form of the evidence but also conducted a comprehensive analysis in conjunction with the time and quantity of sales of "Jinhe 880" to third parties recorded in other evidence submitted by Jinhe Company. Based on the comprehensive analysis, the court of first instance did not accept the probative force of this evidence, which was not improper.

综上所述，雅玉公司的部分上诉请求成立，应予支持；金禾公司的上诉请求不能成立，应予驳回。依照《中华人民共和国民事诉讼法》第一百七十七条第一款第二项之规定，判决如下：

In summary, Yayu Company's partial appeal request is established and should be supported; Jinhe Company's appeal request cannot be established and should be dismissed.
